title: The Fifth Page of the Tianji
next_chapter_hook: At the entrance of the ruins, Chen Xuan's inscription appeared: 'Those who enter this gate shall understand what Heaven's Secrets truly mean.' In the shadows of the Imperial Capital, countless eyes were死死盯着那道冲天而起的金光。

text.content: Western suburbs of the Imperial Capital, night as dark as ink. Chen Ji sat cross-legged in an underground chamber deep within the ruins, spiritual energy churning wildly around him like stampeding horses. In the depths of his Mental Sea, the fragmented Tianji Record trembled violently, the golden light of the first four pages flickering unsteadily, as if enduring some indescribable shock.

The Fifth Page... is about to manifest. A profound ancient fluctuation resonated from the depths of his consciousness. This energy diverged sharply from the preceding four pages—it offered neither cultivation nor blessing, but rather a savage, primeval pressure, as if an invisible hand descended from the heavens, threatening to crush him into oblivion.

dialogue.content: It has arrived. Mo Xiansheng's spirit manifested beside Chen Ji, his voice unusually grave. The Fifth Page of the Tianji Record documents the 'Destiny Calamity.' Its manifestation signifies that your karmic entanglement with the Heavenly Dao's Eye has emerged from concealment into the open.

text.content: Before the words could finish, the Tianji Record erupted with blinding golden radiance. The Fifth Page surged forth like crashing waves, an overwhelming torrent of information pouring into Chen Ji's spirit like a breached dam. In that instant, he witnessed—stars inverted across the heavens, countless threads of destiny weaving into a web, and at the web's center, a cold, merciless giant eye slowly opening.

dialogue.content: Found you. The voice did not reach through his ears but exploded directly within his soul, ice-cold, ancient, utterly devoid of emotion. Traitor of the Tianji Record... do you truly believe that hiding in this mortal realm will shield you from my sight?

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The Heavenly Dao's Eye—that ultimate existence meant to appear only in Volume Eight—had already locked onto his position the moment the Fifth Page manifested. A chill shot from his spine to his crown, a higher-dimensional gaze that made any mortal tremble instinctively like an ant gazing at the heavens.

dialogue.content: Do not panic! Mo Xiansheng roared, his remnant spirit blazing with brilliant light, forcibly tearing a barrier between Chen Ji's soul and that probing gaze. The manifestation of the Fifth Page is merely the beginning. Though the Heavenly Dao's Eye has sensed you, it cannot strike across the void—this is bound by Heavenly Dao law!

text.content: Just then, the sky above the western suburbs of the Imperial Capital tore apart. A golden pillar of light, several zhang wide, shot skyward, piercing the clouds and stirring the winds across eight directions. A vast, inscrutable pressure materialized between heaven and earth, like an ancient divine mountain toppling over, forcing all living things within a hundred li to prostrate themselves.

Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, gazing through the cracks of the chamber at that pillar of light. His Tianji Record trembled violently, the Fifth Page's content seared into his spirit like a brand—'Chen Xuan's Ruins, those who enter this gate shall understand what Heaven's Secrets truly mean.' The ruins' entrance had actually manifested in the outskirts of the Imperial Capital!

dialogue.content: This is... Master's cenotaph! Mo Xiansheng's voice rose sharply, filled with unbelievable shock. I believed those ruins had long been eroded by time, yet they resurface on the very day the Fifth Page of the Tianji Record manifests... Is this mere coincidence, or destiny written in the heavens?

text.content: In the Taiji Hall within the inner city of the Imperial Capital, the emperor abruptly rose from reviewing memorials. His dragon eyes reflected that soaring pillar of light beyond the window, his expression dramatically shifting. Simultaneously, the intelligence networks of the three major sects within the capital all activated. Countless sword-messages streaked through the air, racing toward their respective sect headquarters.

At the Xuanwu Sect residence, a white-haired elder stood atop a high tower, his murky old eyes flickering with sharp light. Behind him, several figures with concealed auras quietly appeared, each radiating a terrifying pressure. The ruins have emerged... those old fools from the Tianqing Sect probably can't sit still anymore.

Meanwhile, deep within the inner sect of the Tianqing Sect, Su Qingyao stood before a window, gazing at that dazzling golden light in the western sky. She clutched the jade pendant Chen Ji had left her before his departure, her fingers unconsciously stroking its patterns. A complex, indescribable expression flickered across her eyes.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji... how many more secrets are you keeping from me? Su Qingyao murmured softly, her knuckles whitening from tension. The ancient aura contained within that golden light closely matched the mysterious fluctuation she had once sensed from Chen Ji—her intuition told her this supposedly worthless junior brother was far more profound than he appeared.

text.content: As undercurrents surged through the Imperial Capital, Chen Ji found himself in an unprecedented predicament. Though the manifestation of the Fifth Page granted him new abilities, it also completely exposed his location. His feigned death as the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor had become a blade suspended above his head—the intelligence networks of the three major sects were already activated, and his true identity could be exposed at any moment.

choice.prompt: Golden light pierced the heavens, the ruins' entrance had appeared. Chen Ji sensed the gazes from all directions, knowing his time was running out. He had to make a choice—

choices.description: Seizing the moment before forces react, stepping into the ruins first. The highest risk, but if he can obtain Chen Xuan's legacy, it could completely change the current passive situation.
choices.visible_cost: Possible encounter with unknown dangers within the ruins, as well as exposure of whereabouts
choices.visible_reward: Chen Xuan's legacy, Tianji Record may further improve
choices.risk_hint: The mechanisms and formations within the ruins are unclear, and one might be ambushed while waiting
choices.process_label: all or nothing, enter tiger's den

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze hardened, spiritual light erupted around him, and his entire being transformed into a streak of light hurtling toward that golden pillar. He had already made his calculations—better to take the initiative than to wait for death. Though the ruins were perilous, they also concealed the key to breaking the deadlock.

choices.description: Hold your position and observe quietly. Leverage the advantage of your fake death identity, let the three major sects probe each other first, and wait for the situation to clarify before acting. Cautious, but you might miss the first opportunity.
choices.visible_cost: Might miss the opportunities within the ruin, allowing others to seize the first move.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain identity concealment, do not reveal the existence of the Tianji Record.
choices.risk_hint: The opportunities within the ruin might fall into others' hands.

text.content: Chen Ji concealed his aura and hid back into the shadows. He calmly analyzed the situation - the three major sects would never tolerate anyone monopolizing the ruin. Rather than rushing to the front as a target himself, better to let this pack of greedy wolves tear each other apart first.

choices.description: Since your identity might be exposed, proactively ignite this hidden danger. Turn the tables, exploit everyone's covetousness for the ruin, secretly arrange plans, transforming everyone into pieces on your own chessboard.
choices.visible_cost: Requires consuming significant energy to set up multiple chess games.
choices.visible_reward: Transform passivity into initiative, make enemies into your own chess pieces.
choices.risk_hint: Once the scheme is discovered, you will become the target of everyone's attacks.
choices.process_label: turn force against them, fish in troubled waters

text.content: A faint cunning gleam flickered in Chen Ji's eyes. He took out several jade slips from his embrace and began imprinting information with his divine consciousness - he was going to add more fuel to this upcoming chaos.

Just as Chen Ji was contemplating, subtle footsteps echoed in the ruins outside the secret chamber. The visitor deliberately subdued their aura, yet their gait carried a unique rhythm - this was a breathing technique unique to inner disciples of the Tianqing Sect. Chen Ji's eyes flickered slightly - the visitor was Su Qingyao.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji, I know you're here.' Su Qingyao's cold voice drifted through the stone walls, carrying an undeniable weariness. 'The news of the Crown Prince Grand Tutor's death was a lie, wasn't it? From the very beginning, you've been deceiving me.'

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened. Su Qingyao had tracked him here - it seemed this Inner Disciple Senior Fellow's intuition was sharper than he'd anticipated. He took a deep breath and waved to解除 the secret chamber's formation. The stone door slowly opened, revealing Su Qingyao's icy-cold face. Under the moonlight, her eyes held too many complex emotions.

dialogue.content: 'Who exactly are you?' Su Qingyao stared directly into Chen Ji's eyes, her voice trembling slightly. 'Crown Prince Grand Tutor, Chen Ji... how many identities do you actually have? What was that golden light just now? I need an explanation!'

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao has already tracked down near the truth. Her aura is somewhat unstable, clearly emotionally agitated. Chen Ji needs to respond -

choices.description: Admit that the Crown Prince Grand Tutor identity was a disguise, but conceal the existence of the Tianji Record. Reveal that the ruin is related to the Tianqing Sect, giving her a reason she can accept, maintaining the fragile cooperative relationship.
choices.visible_cost: Might drag her into a larger maelstrom.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Su Qingyao's trust and assistance.
choices.risk_hint: If she digs deeper, she might still discover the secret of the Tianji Record.

text.content: Chen Ji met Su Qingyao's gaze, his expression calm yet vigilant: 'Senior Sister is indeed perceptive. The Crown Prince Grand Tutor... is indeed one of my identities for traveling the world. But some things, now is not the time to tell you.'

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶首次触及真相边缘

choices.description: Deny everything, use prepared excuses to appease her. Better to create distance with her than to let her know the existence of the Tianji Record. This is to protect her, and also to protect yourself.
choices.visible_cost: Might lose Su Qingyao as a potential ally.
choices.visible_reward: The secret of the Tianji Record is temporarily safe.
choices.risk_hint: Her suspicions will only grow heavier and heavier.

text.content: Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged as he said calmly, "Senior Sister may be mistaken. I was merely secluding myself here for cultivation, and have no connection to that golden light." His gaze was calm as still water, showing no flaw whatsoever.

choices.memory_label: 陈机再次否认，苏青瑶疑心加深

text.content: At this moment, the golden pillar of light in the sky suddenly transformed, and a line of ancient seal characters coalesced in the void—"Those who enter this gate shall know what Heavenly Secrets truly are." Chen Xuan's handwriting, undiminished through ten thousand years, now proclaimed this to the world. The imperial capital quaked, and the three great sects all dispatched their strongest advance teams.

Chen Ji withdrew his gaze from the void and looked again at Su Qingyao before him. The moonlight stretched their shadows long, and the night wind swept across the ruins, bringing with it a mournful wail. He knew that from this moment, everything had changed—the fifth page of the Tianji Record had manifested, the ruins had reopened, and his karmic connection to the Eye of Heavenly Secrets had emerged.

Beneath the night sky of the imperial capital, countless escape lights were racing toward the entrance of the ruins. The era of great contest had truly arrived. Chen Ji stood among the ruins, his eyes reflecting the towering golden light, yet a meaningful smile curved his lips—the chess game had begun, and the pieces he held in his hand were far more numerous than anyone could have imagined.
